answer_1.quote: Automatic text simplification (ATS) aims to creates easier-to-read text while keeping the original meaning... Our three contributions are: 1. We proposed a new dimension to evaluate ATS system output for legal ATS...
answer_1.outputs: Simplified legal texts generated from complex insurance contract sentences

answer_2.quote: For example, BLEU is commonly used to evaluate fluency, while SARI is for simplicity... We selected the following ones: • BERTScore • Sentence Transformer • Coverage • QuestEval • LENS • MeaningBERT

answer_4.quote: We selected five native French-speaking law students at the Faculty of Law of University Laval as our annotators... The annotators must determine one of TS's three dimensions, simplicity, along with our new fourth dimension to replace the 'meaning' dimension.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess simplicity level and legal meaning preservation using a 4-level scale for simplicity and a 10-point Likert scale for legal meaning. They follow a three-step process: characterization, preliminary scoring, and error-based adjustment.
